messages:
maria_support: FYI — NordicMed procurement just replied. They will not accept any invoice unless we have an official PO that references the signed SOW, a valid internal cost center code, and their signed SLA addendum uploaded to their vendor portal. They also asked for our VAT cert (they listed VAT: SE123456789). Quote: "No invoice will be released without a matching PO." Can billing hold issuance?

ben_billing: Thanks — we can hold. Quick Q: do they require the PO number on the invoice (yes) or a legal PO upload first? If they only give PO later we can issue a pro-forma and reissue a final invoice once PO arrives. Otherwise we'll block. :thinking_face:

kevin_sales: I pinged the procurement POC (Lena). She said they run everything through Coupa and need vendor registration + the SLA addendum signed. She's sent a vendor form link. Asked for the exact upload filename they want. I'll push for PO but timeline looks like 2–4 business days.

sara_acct_mgr: On it — I'll collect the SLA signature and cost-center code. Suggest we prepare a pro-forma invoice marked "Pending PO" so customer can process internally while procurement generates the PO. Need approval from Finance for the workaround (impact on recognition).

anna_legal: We can sign the SLA addendum; recommend we sign with the same effective date as the SOW. For invoicing: be careful with credit notes if we reissue later. If they insist on issuing only with PO, we should document acceptance in the contract thread to avoid disputes later.

ariba_bot: Vendor registration URL: https://vendor.nordicmed.coupa/upload
Required PO fields: ```PO#, PO date, Line item description (SOW id), Amount, Cost center code, VAT ID```

maria_support: Recap/action items: 1) Sales (kevin) escalate for PO creation and vendor portal confirmation; 2) Sara to collect signed SLA addendum + cost center; 3) Billing (ben) hold final invoice issuance until PO is received OR approve pro-forma as temporary; 4) Legal (anna) to sign SLA; 5) Tag FIN ticket FIN-4872 and mark as "procurement hold". Please post updates here. :thumbsup:

ben_billing: I'll tentatively prepare a pro-forma template and hold final invoice. If Finance approves, we'll send pro-forma with note: "Final invoice will be issued on receipt of PO# and vendor confirmation." Otherwise we wait.

kevin_sales: Lena replied — vendor upload complete but procurement requires our signed SLA before they will issue PO. She said PO will be back once SLA uploaded, probably EOD tomorrow. Sharing POC email in DM.

sara_acct_mgr: Received signed SLA PDF from legal, uploaded to their portal and included our VAT cert (SE123456789). Waiting for PO. Updated FIN-4872 with links.

maria_support: Thanks team — holding invoice issuance. If PO doesn't arrive by EOD+2, @ben_billing escalate to CFO for one-time exception to issue with placeholder PO and post-credit once final PO matches.

anna_legal: Noted. Add clause in ticket: "invoice reissue and credit note policy applied in case of PO mismatch".

ben_billing: Got it — will only issue final invoice once PO matches SOW line items. Pro-forma ready if Finance gives OK.

maria_support: Closing the loop here for now. Will update thread when PO arrives. If anything changes, ping this thread. :white_check_mark:
